ratios.covenant_name: consolidated first lien net leverage ratio
ratios.quote: With respect to the Revolving Facility, the Credit Agreement requires the Company to maintain a consolidated first lien net leverage ratio (as defined in the Credit Agreement) of no greater than 6.25 to 1.00 if more than 35 % of the Revolving Facility has been drawn, which was the case as of September 30, 2026.

ratios.facility: Aireon Credit Agreement (Aireon Holdings and its subsidiaries)
ratios.quote: In addition, the Aireon Credit Agreement contains a financial covenant requiring Aireon Holdings and its subsidiaries to maintain, on a consolidated basis as of the last day of each quarterly period, a consolidated total leverage ratio, as defined in the Aireon Credit Agreement, of not more than 5.00 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: The Credit Agreement has no financial maintenance covenant for the Term Loan. The 6.25x first lien net leverage covenant is a springing test for the Revolving Facility. It applies only when more than 35% of the revolver is drawn, which was the case at 9/30/2026. No actual ratio is disclosed; the company states only that it was in compliance. The 3.5x thresholds (commitment fee step-down and excess cash flow sweep) are excluded because they are not maintenance covenants. The Aireon covenant applies to Aireon Holdings, which appears to be a consolidated subsidiary following the Aireon Closing. It is a separate subsidiary-level borrower, not Iridium itself. The excerpt does not state Aireon's actual ratio or confirm compliance specifically.
